blurb: Bearded Iris Brewing produces a variety of beers focusing on IPAs, DIPAs, and pales, emphasizing hop varietals and ingredient possibilities. Guests can visit their Germantown taproom in Nashville, which is a production facility where the brewing area is visible. The taproom is BYO food friendly, hosts private and public events, and welcomes well-behaved children and pets on patios.
